steps.label: Obtain and Install Top Ducts Driver Side and Passenger side
Obtain and Install Front Center Duct
Torque top ducts driver and passenger side with (2) screws
Torque (5) Screws to secure Front Center Duct
Torque (2) screws to secure SWD Ducts
Torque (1) Top Duct screw underneath Driver side
Torque (1) top duct screw to secure passenger side duct
Seat HVAC Blower and Actuator Connections. Witness Mark connections
Make Radio connections and Witness mark.
Place Passenger Side WH branch into the hook on the AGC frame
OPTION: If Steering column lock box is present make 2 fur tree...
